# Content Quality & Discovery

### 1. Topic/Category System
Tags are free-form. Add curated topics (Technology, Design, Career, etc.) that users can follow — improves feed personalization significantly.

### 2. Recommendation Engine
Use collaborative filtering: "Users who liked X also liked Y." Even a simple tag-overlap algorithm would improve discovery beyond just "trending."

### 3. Table of Contents (Auto-Generated)
For long posts, auto-generate a TOC from headings. Improves readability and reduces bounce.

### 4. Code Syntax Highlighting & Embeds
Add proper code blocks with language detection, GitHub Gist embeds, and CodePen/StackBlitz embeds for developer-focused content.

### 5. SEO & Open Graph Previews
Generate proper OG meta tags per post so links shared on Twitter/LinkedIn show rich previews with images and excerpts.
